jobs.occupation: Junior Developer: Data Center Automation
jobs.description:
Company description:
Ericsson AB
Job description:   Join our Team   About this opportunity:
 Are you curious about technology and excited to turn ideas into solutions that make a real difference?
 We are looking for a junior Developer who is eager to grow, learn, and help us bring more automation into our datacenter environments. You will join a team to develop smarter and more efficient workflows across our global datacenter sites, while ensuring our solutions align with Ericsson's security directives and frameworks. The team works together with operations and lifecycle management of server HW in the datacenter as well as creating automated workflows for other teams within our global datacenter operations.
 You will be part of our journey to make our datacenter environments smarter through automation. Working together with experienced colleagues, you will help automate repetitive tasks, improve workflows, and develop solutions that make our labs more efficient and reliable. You will also work hands-on in the datacenter, managing different server environments. It's a role where you can learn, experiment, take initiative, and grow your technical skills while contributing to real R&D challenges.
  
 What you will do:
  Develop and maintain automation solutions for lab workflows using Python and/or Java.
 Build and support full-stack applications with Angular or React on the frontend and backend, using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript/TypeScript.
 Work with relational databases such as MySQL or PostgreSQL, writing and optimizing SQL queries.
 Use containers and orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes and use GenAI agents to improve the development cycle.
 Apply application security fundamentals, such as secure coding and handling of sensitive data.
 Take part in the full SDLC, from requirements, design, and development to testing, deployment, and maintenance, using an agile way of working.
  
 
 The skills you bring:
  A technical educational background within IT,  system administration, software development, computer science or a related field
 A strong interest in technology and a willingness to learn new things
 A curious, proactive, and solution-oriented mindset
 The confidence to take initiative and explore new ideas
 An interest in collaborating with others and contributing to a team
 A service-minded approach
 Good knowledge in English, both verbally and in writing

jobs.occupation: Senior Electrical Engineer  Cable Harness Routing Design - 20720 - 1
jobs.description:
Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. Job Overview
Assignment Description
We are seeking a Senior Electrical Engineer specializing in cable harness routing design to support the development of new vehicle platforms and products.
You will design, develop, and release cable harness routing solutions that meet electrical, mechanical, manufacturing, serviceability, quality, and cost requirements.
Working closely with cross-functional engineering teams and suppliers, you will contribute throughout the product development lifecycle, from concept and detailed design to prototype builds, verification, industrialization, and engineering changes.

Design and develop cable harness routing solutions using CAD.
Create, maintain, and update 3D routing models and technical documentation.
Optimize routing designs for packaging, robustness, manufacturability, serviceability, quality, and cost.
Collaborate with electrical architects, component owners, mechanical designers, manufacturing engineering, purchasing, and suppliers.
Participate in design reviews and technical discussions.
Perform tolerance analyses and evaluate installation feasibility.
Support prototype builds, verification, troubleshooting, and issue resolution.
Manage engineering changes and maintain accurate product documentation.
Contribute to improvements in design methods, technical standards, and engineering practices.

What You Bring
Experience in cable harness routing or mechanical installation design.
Understanding of vehicle or product development processes.
Knowledge of Design for Manufacturing (DfM) and Design for Assembly (DfA).
Experience with 3D CAD systems, preferably CATIA V5 or CATIA 3DEXPERIENCE.
Experience working in cross-functional product development teams.
Ability to develop robust engineering solutions based on technical requirements.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities independently and collaboratively.
Swedish and English communication skills.
Previous experience in the automotive or commercial vehicle industry.

Meritorious
Experience with electrical distribution systems and cable harness architecture.
CATIA V5 or CATIA 3DEXPERIENCE experience specifically in cable harness routing.
Knowledge of PLM systems such as ENOVIA.
Experience supporting prototype builds, verification, and production issue resolution.
Additional European language skills.

jobs.occupation: Automotive Cybersecurity Engineer – Software-Defined Vehicles
jobs.description:
Vehicles are increasingly defined by software: centralised computing, over-the-air updates and connected services. That makes cybersecurity a core part of vehicle development. Cyber Instincts is building a network of automotive cybersecurity specialists to take on assignments with OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers in the Gothenburg region. If you work with product cybersecurity and want to help shape secure, software-defined vehicles, we’d like to hear from you.
What you could work on

Threat Analysis and Risk Assessment (TARA) at component, function and vehicle level

Defining cybersecurity goals, concepts and requirements together with architects and system designers

Securing software-defined vehicle architectures: central compute, zonal architectures and vehicle-to-cloud connectivity

Secure boot, secure software updates and OTA, key management and PKI

Supporting compliance with ISO/SAE 21434, UNECE R155/R156 and type approval

Supplier cybersecurity reviews and work product assessments

Vulnerability management and post-production cybersecurity monitoring

What we’re looking for

Experience in automotive or embedded cybersecurity

Hands-on experience with TARA and ISO/SAE 21434

Good understanding of UNECE R155/R156 and CSMS

Ability to work with architects, developers, suppliers and other stakeholders

Fluent English. Swedish is a plus.

It’s a plus if you have experience with

Software-defined vehicles: service-oriented architectures (SOA), AUTOSAR Adaptive, high-performance computers (HPC) and zonal architectures

Connected vehicles: OTA/SUMS, vehicle-to-cloud security, V2X and telematics

Embedded security: HSM, secure boot, SecOC, secure diagnostics (UDS 0x27/0x29) and cryptography

Platforms: AUTOSAR Classic, Linux/QNX and Android Automotive

Networks: CAN/CAN FD, automotive Ethernet, MACsec and IDS/IDPS

Secure development: secure software development, DevSecOps, SBOM and supply-chain security

Testing: security testing and penetration testing of ECUs and vehicle systems

Related standards: ISO 26262 (functional safety), ISO/SAE 21434 with China GB 44495, and the Cyber Resilience Act (CRA)

What we offer

Assignments with leading automotive companies in the Gothenburg region

The choice of employment at Cyber Instincts or working with us as an independent subconsultant

A small, specialised cybersecurity company with short decision paths and close contact with management

Location: Gothenburg. The setup is hybrid or on-site depending on the assignment.
We review applications continuously, and you are welcome to apply even if we have no matching assignment right now.

jobs.occupation: Senior Hardware Design Engineer
jobs.description:
Swedium Global Services is the growing System Engineering and Solution Company, offers services like Semiconductor Engineering R&D Services, Embedded Systems Development, Custom Application Software Development, Web and Cloud Application Development, Testing Services, Consultancy and Outsourcing services to our clients across the globe for an onsite and offshore business model. Swedium Global is having presence in Sweden, Finland, Poland, Czech Republic and in India.
Location - Onsite, Sweden
Job Title - Senior Hardware Design Engineer

We are looking for a senior Hardware Design Engineer having experience in BMS
Requirements
This is a senior, hands-on engineering role. You will take battery subsystem requirements and turn them into robust BMS hardware solutions together with system engineers, cell specialists, software engineers and manufacturing experts

Your responsibilities
Derive hardware requirements from battery subsystem requirements and translate them into practical design choices.
Define BMS hardware architecture and functional blocks based on system architecture, requirements, standards and certification needs.
Create schematics and PCB designs in OrCAD, including symbols, footprints and production-ready documentation.
Define the BMS interfaces to the battery system and contribute to the optimal EE layout of the battery design.
Select electronic and electrical components with the right balance of performance, safety, availability and manufacturability.
Prepare manufacturing deliverables for PCBA production and support test, troubleshooting, verification and validation.
Define AFE parameters, operating modes and BMS functions in close collaboration with cell experts, system engineers and software engineers.
Specify the hardware–software interface together with the software team and ensure clear, structured technical documentation.

The technical landscape
You will work close to the product and close to the details. The role suits someone who enjoys circuit-level problem solving, knows the trade-offs in BMS hardware, and can move naturally between architecture, schematic design, PCBA realization, verification and cross-functional decision-making.

What we believe you bring
BSc or MSc in Electronics, Embedded Systems, Electrical Engineering or a related field.
Minimum 6 years of relevant professional experience in electronics/hardware development.
Documented experience in hardware design for Battery Management Systems — this is essential.
Strong experience in circuit and PCBA design and the confidence to work independently in complex designs.
Hands-on experience with AFEs, MCUs and BMS-related hardware architectures.
At least 3 years of OrCAD experience for schematic and PCB design.
Fluent English, both spoken and written.

Work description:
We are looking for a Cloud Platform & DevOps Engineer with 5+ years of experience to own the infrastructure, security and automation of our AWS Virtual Engineering Workbench (VEW). VEW is a serverless self-service platform that lets our engineers launch secure, cloud-based development environments on demand. You will run and extend it, and work with our engineering teams to bring automotive toolchains such as MATLAB/Simulink, AUTOSAR tooling, compilers and simulators into the cloud.
Prior experience with VEW itself is not required. We are looking for strong hands-on experience with the AWS services it is built on.
Responsibilities:
Deploy, operate and evolve the VEW backend using infrastructure as code
Maintain the self-service catalog of virtual workstations (Amazon DCV) and engineering environments
Automate the AMI lifecycle for engineering toolchains
Integrate VEW with identity (Microsoft Entra ID), license servers and code repositories
Build CI/CD pipelines for the platform and for the teams that use it
Work with our platform engineers to manage floating licenses for specialized tools

Skills & Experience required:
5+ years building and operating production workloads on AWS
Infrastructure as code: AWS CDK, Terraform or similar
Serverless on AWS: Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, Step Functions, EventBridge
Python
AWS multi-account setup and security: Organizations, IAM, cross-account access, VPC networking
Identity federation with Amazon Cognito and an enterprise identity provider (Entra ID / Active Directory)
AWS Service Catalog and EC2 Image Builder (or Packer)
CI/CD with GitHub Actions or AWS CodePipeline
You have prior work experience from the automotive industry
Degree in SW/IT or similar
Fluent in English is a must and Swedish is a plus

A plus if you have:
Hands-on experience with AWS Virtual Engineering Workbench
Automotive industry background
Packaging R&D toolchains (MATLAB/Simulink, AUTOSAR, cross-compilers) into AMIs or containers
FlexNet/FlexLM or other floating-license server administration
SIL test pipelines, and connecting cloud pipelines to HIL rigs
Virtual ECUs, vehicle environment models, or MBSE tooling
Amazon DCV, Windows and Linux image hardening

Softskills:
You are flexible and pro-active and driven
You are communicative and can easily create a network
You enjoy teamwork and working cross-functionally
